import unreal
# Add a User Parameter of type RenderTarget2D pointing to our asset, via NiagaraSystem editor API.
sysa=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest')
rt=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
print('rt',rt)
# Discover NiagaraSystem exposed methods for user parameters
ms=[m for m in dir(sysa) if 'param' in m.lower() or 'user' in m.lower() or 'expose' in m.lower()]
print('SYS_METHODS',ms)
# NiagaraEditor library?
lib=[n for n in dir(unreal) if 'NiagaraEditor' in n or 'NiagaraSystemEditor' in n or n=='NiagaraFunctionLibrary']
print('LIBS',lib[:20])
